about.title: About
about.intro: Language is much more than words.

paragraphs.1: It is how a child discovers the world, builds relationships, and understands where they belong. Through language, family stories, memories, values, and culture are passed on. That is why preserving a heritage language in a multilingual environment is not simply about learning one more language - it is an investment in a child's connection to family, roots, and community.
paragraphs.2: Kutak za srpski was born from that belief.
paragraphs.3: We are a Serbian language school for children growing up in New York and for their families. Our programs are designed specifically for children who learn Serbian as a heritage language, and they are grounded in contemporary research in linguistics, psycholinguistics, developmental psychology, and language teaching methodology. Each program follows a child's natural development and respects the realities of growing up in a multilingual environment.
paragraphs.4: We believe language grows best when it becomes part of everyday life. That is why children learn through conversation, play, literature, music, movement, and shared exploration. Our goal is not for children to memorize words or grammar rules, but to use Serbian naturally, with understanding and confidence.
paragraphs.5: Parents are an equally important part of our work. A wide range of studies shows that family plays a crucial role in preserving a heritage language. That is why we build our programs as a partnership with parents - offering support, practical guidance, and a clear understanding of the challenges of growing up between two or more languages.
paragraphs.6: At Kutak za srpski, children develop far more than language skills. They build confidence, curiosity, and a sense of belonging. They learn to speak with grandma and grandpa without translating, to understand the stories that shaped their families, to read, sing, ask questions, imagine, and express themselves in the language that is part of their identity.
paragraphs.7: We believe success is not measured by the number of words learned, but by how naturally Serbian becomes part of a child's life.
paragraphs.8: That is why Kutak za srpski is much more than a language school. It is a place where expertise and warmth come together, where curiosity is nurtured, bilingualism is encouraged, and where families can protect what they most hope to pass on to their children - the ability to understand one another, to connect, and to belong, in their own language.

founder.title: About the Founder
founder.bio: Kutak za srpski was founded by Ivana Djurovic. She was born and raised in Belgrade. She completed her undergraduate and master's studies at the Department of English Language and Literature at the University of Belgrade, followed by a master's degree in linguistics at the University of Iowa. She also spent some time in Brazil, where she taught English to students of different ages. Later, during her doctoral studies in linguistics in New York (Graduate Center, CUNY), she gave birth to her daughter Klara and wished to create an environment where she could pass on and nurture the linguistic and cultural heritage of her home country. Ivana and Klara are wholeheartedly supported in all of this by dad Michael.
